title: FAO Committee on Forestry (COFO 28) Closes in Rome; Proposed UN Decade for Afforestation and Reforestation 2027–2036 Gains Backing
detail: The 28th session of the FAO Committee on Forestry met in Rome from September 28 to October 2, 2026. In his opening statement, FAO Director-General Qu Dongyu cited SOFO 2026: 1.56 billion hectares of land degraded, including 460 million hectares of forest, and 91 countries pledging to restore 190 million hectares. India reaffirmed support for a proposed UN Decade for Afforestation and Reforestation (2027–2036) and pressed for measurable restoration results and climate/biodiversity finance. No official confirmation of a formal COFO endorsement of the Decade was found; treat as expressed support only.
